question: Can a `- id: llm-pi-ai / name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai'` row be resolved and applied from the profile composition, and does the user's provider/credential/catalog surface come alive?

answers.q1_row_resolved_and_applied: YES. No resolution error and no apply error: the row is already in @deepseek-ai/dsh-base's patch (enabled) and a boot of the composition registers its routes (opencode-go appears in ctx.llm.listProviders()). The plugin resolves from <DSH_HOME>/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai -> the install tree. Experiment D adds an EXPLICIT user-layer row with the same id/name and it also resolves and applies with an identical registry.

q3_credential.mechanism: credentials service resolve(ref) — config resolution only, no network

q4_catalog.projection: faithful copy of the host's buildModelCatalog (ctx.llm.listProviders + listModels + resolveModelInfo)

answers.q5_enabling_change: NONE. The user's real environment already satisfies every requirement: the row is mounted by the base bundle, the plugin resolves through <DSH_HOME>/profiles/node_modules, the settings document supplies the routes and the credential ref resolves. No dependency/install step and no patch edit is required. IF a reader still observes one provider, the measured discriminator is experiment F: a boot whose DSH_HOME lacks settings.yaml shows exactly deepseek-official alone.

api_quota.note: resolveCallConfig validates model capability only; it does not resolve credentials and performs no provider I/O. No prepareCall/stream/discovery call was made.

unproven: The LIVE process behind http://127.0.0.1:3080 was not instrumented (read-only rule + a remote RPC surface); what the running process currently holds in its registry was NOT measured. Only a FRESH boot of the identical composition was.
The origin of the 'exactly one provider' observation is not proven; experiment F shows a settings-less boot reproduces that exact picture, which is the strongest available hypothesis.
Whether the running process would pick up an already-present settings block without a restart (settings is hot-reloaded via installSection, but no live observation was taken).
No model completion was issued, so provider reachability/validity of the key against the upstream gateway is unproven (out of scope by the quota rule).
